text:
Type: dark wall shelf with wooden brackets
Use: holding books, frames and decor above a desk or sideboard; living room, home office, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: black-brown wood-effect board, black-brown stained solid wood brackets
Colors: dark black-brown
Shape: long flat shelf on two angled triangular brackets with a diagonal strut, simple straight lines, matching dark finish throughout, sturdy yet light
Feel: grounded, calm, tidy, warm
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, black frames, green plants; Scandinavian, modern or minimalist rooms
